copy.tagline: 用 TypeScript 构建 RAG 与智能代理工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 LlamaIndex 做 RAG 或代理应用
copy.tagline_en: Build RAG and agentic workflows with TypeScript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building RAG or agent applications with LlamaIndex

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 TypeScript 构建 RAG 应用：加载文档、建立向量索引、查询引擎，以及创建带工具调用的智能体。
howto.when: 当你提到 LlamaIndex、VectorStoreIndex、SimpleDirectoryReader 等关键词，或要求构建 RAG、文档问答、智能体工作流时触发。

say.text: 用 LlamaIndex 加载 ./data 目录的文档并创建索引。
帮我写一个查询引擎，回答关于文档的问题。
创建一个能调用天气工具的智能体。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you build RAG apps in TypeScript: load documents, create vector indexes, query engines, and agents with tool calling.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like LlamaIndex, VectorStoreIndex, SimpleDirectoryReader, or ask to build RAG, document Q&A, or agentic workflows.

say_en.text: Use LlamaIndex to load documents from ./data and create an index.
say_en.note: Claude generates SimpleDirectoryReader and VectorStoreIndex code.

say_en.text: Write a query engine to answer questions about the documents.
say_en.note: Claude creates a queryEngine and calls query().

say_en.text: Create an agent that can call a weather tool.
say_en.note: Claude uses tool() and agent() to define tools and agent.
